title: Project: Maze Walker
story: The maze garden is a grid. S is where you start, E is the exit, # is a hedge. Is there a way out?
goal: Write solvable(grid) for a list of strings. Move up, down, left or right through any cell that is not #. Return True if E can be reached from S.
starter: # define solvable (a queue or a stack both work)
hints: Explore from S, remembering which cells you have visited so you never go in circles.
Keep a queue of cells to explore. Take one, add its unvisited open neighbours, repeat. If you reach E, return True; if the queue empties, return False.
socratic: How do you avoid walking in circles?
When can you be sure there is no way out?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Project: Maze Walker”?
